    Without contours, convex pieces are forests #

    If a ray category has no contours, parallel paths of the universal cover with the same nonzero value are equal, so every weight on the arrows is a cocycle. Local simple connectivity then shows that every arrow of a finite convex piece is a bridge (gr_isAcyclic).
